headline: Premier Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Premier Limited has informed the Exchange about Post-Facto Intimation of the Twenty-First Meeting of Committee of Creditors ( CoC ) of Premier Limited, the Corporate Debtor was scheduled on…
detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Premier Limited has informed the Exchange about Post-Facto Intimation of the Twenty-First Meeting of Committee of Creditors ( CoC ) of Premier Limited, the Corporate Debtor was scheduled on Thursday, December 11th, 2025 at 11:00 A.M., rescheduled and duly held on Friday, December 12th, 2025 at 12:00 P.M.

sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
